text:
Maya: quick heads-up — noticed a 22% drop in webinar -> MQL conversion yesterday on the performance dashboard. looks like most of the delta is from the EMEA cohort. link: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/perf/webinar-conversions :eyes:

Jon: saw that too. initial check: funnel counts look fine but the attribution window shrunk for a subset of entries (7d -> 1d?) — could be ETL change or a dashboard filter flip. running a quick cohort diff now.

Lee: throwing a quick sql to compare raw leads vs attributed mqls
```
SELECT day, source, count(*) AS raw_leads, sum(attributed_mql) AS mqls
FROM raw.leads
WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-02-10' AND '2026-02-13'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY day;
```

Ashley: FYI I saw a spike in postback 502s from the CRM connector around 03:00 UTC yesterday. replay job retried but some messages were dropped. logs: `crm-postback/2026-02-12/03:12`

Sam: we deployed landing-variant-b last night at 22:45 PST. small copy + form change — could change conversion signal for MQL detection. paused it just now. :thinking:

GrowthBot: alert: webinar_conversion_rate anomaly detected (score 7.4) for EMEA cohort on 2026-02-12 03:12 UTC.

Maya: ok action plan: @Lee can you confirm whether attribution joins (email vs cookie) regressed? @Ashley pls surface the CRM postback failure rows and timestamp range. @Jon rebuild the 7d attribution window cohort and compare. @Sam thanks, keep variant paused until we rule it out. can we get initial findings by EOD? :+1:

Lee: will do. first glance suggests a new join_key nulling for a small % (0.6%) after yesterday's ETL tweak. digging in now.

Ashley: pulling logs and will upload a CSV to the shared folder (`/shared/marketing/postback-failures/2026-02-12.csv`). ETA 90m.

Jon: rebuilding cohorts — I'll run both 1d and 7d attribution windows and post a diff. quick heads-up: if we revert to 7d we may recover ~14% of the missing mqls based on a dry run.

Sam: noted. leaving variant paused. if the join_key fix helps, we can re-run the A/B with stricter event dedupe.

Maya: thanks team. if anyone uncovers something urgent ping me directly. otherwise we'll reconvene tomorrow morning at 10:00 for a short sync. :calendar:

Lee: quick update — found the ETL change in `etl/normalize_lead_keys` that introduced a `NULLIF` on cookie_id when email exists. rolling a patch to preserve cookie_id for attribution. testing now.

Jon: nice catch. once Lee confirms patch results, I'll re-run the report and push an updated dashboard snapshot.

Ashley: uploaded CSV and flagged 124 postbacks with 502 errors between 02:58-03:22 UTC. raising a ticket with CRM team now.

Maya: perfect. small wins — looks like two independent issues (postback errors + ETL join change). good to split but both on path to fix. thanks everyone. :rocket:

Sam: thx. will also roll-back the copy tweak that might be affecting form validation rules.

GrowthBot: summary generated: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/alerts/3049001234-summary (auto)

Jon: tagging this for the weekly KPI review doc so we can include the root-cause and remediation in Friday notes.

Maya: added to the agenda. end.
